description: This file defines the Gitlab provider class for OAuth2 authentication within a PHP application. It extends the AbstractProvider class, implementing methods to generate URLs for authorization, token retrieval, and user details, as well as handling scope management and response validation specific to GitLab's OAuth2 API.

classes.name: Gitlab
classes.description: Provider class for integrating GitLab OAuth2 authentication, providing methods to construct authorization URLs, access token URLs, user resource URLs, handle scope configurations, and process API responses.

methods.name: getBaseAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for initiating the OAuth2 authorization flow.

methods.name: getBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL used to obtain an access token from GitLab.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerDetailsUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to fetch the authenticated user's details.

methods.name: getDefaultScopes
methods.description: Provides the default OAuth scopes, which include 'api'.

methods.name: getScopeSeparator
methods.description: Returns the scope separator used by GitLab (' ').

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Validates the API response for errors and throws exceptions if needed.

methods.name: createResourceOwner
methods.description: Creates a resource owner object representing the authenticated user.
